raw_response:
This small plot is only a tiny piece of my land, and I grow mixed crops on it for my family, not maize for selling. I am old now and have no schooling, and fertilizer from the shop costs too much money for such a small piece. I will put the manure from around the house on it and use the seeds I saved from last harvest, like my mother taught me. My children help me a little, but mostly I work it myself with my hoe.
